code: exif_data_load_data (ExifData *data, const unsigned char *d_orig, unsigned int ds)
note: The EXIF parser starts from attacker-controlled input bytes and length.
The parser caps the overall EXIF segment length, but later offsets are still derived from untrusted contents inside the segment.
The IFD0 offset is read from the input and used to locate directory entries.
The safety obligation is that the computed IFD1 directory span must stay within the available EXIF data before dereferencing it.
The entry count is read from attacker-controlled data and feeds the later pointer arithmetic.
This dereference reads the next-IFD offset from a location computed from the untrusted entry count; if the bounds check is bypassed or miscomputed, it becomes an out-of-bounds read.
